outcomes: Describe and explain the major General Chemistry concepts including atomic theory, reactions, energy, stoichiometry, nomenclature, solutions, materials, acids & bases, electrochemistry, gases, kinetics, equilibrium, thermodynamics and nuclear chemistry, as well as the scientific method.

Describe and explain the major Organic Chemistry concepts including structure, bonding and stereochemistry, nomenclature, the physical/chemical properties of all functional groups, how organic chemical reactions occur via mechanistic diagrams and intermediates, the physical/chemical properties of biomolecules, as well as the synthesis of larger target molecules.
Identify, compare, and contrast all types of General and Organic Chemistry problems and apply math and science concepts to solve them.
Perform various scientific experiments and interpret/analyze data to check agreement with theoretical predictions, and communicate clearly using written, oral, electronic, and graphical means.
Perform various laboratory techniques including the use/application of spectroscopy, and utilize the proper protocols and safety practices in the laboratory.
